scripts.features:
•Before you use the script make sure to Make blocky Avatar.
•Unequip everypart from your avatar and make it a blocky avatar.
•Color your head according to your torso/t-shirt.
•If you wanna make it more realistic then buy mini avatar or some small avatar which contains small head or leg and use them.
•works even after death or respawn and doesn't override animations!
•works on games that supports r15
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local animationId = "rbxassetid://102325931762962"

local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = animationId

local function applyAnimation(character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

	task.wait()

	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	track.Looped = true
	
	track:Play()
	track:AdjustWeight(1, 0)

	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if track then
			track:Stop()
		end
	end)
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
	character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	task.wait(0.1)
	applyAnimation(character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

if player.Character then
	onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
end
